questions: when did I last see a doctor?
how much do I spend on coffee?
what gifts did I plan for my sister?

records.text: The landlord bumped the rate again, starting in March. Third time in two years.
Clinic visit for the cough that won't quit. The GP prescribed antibiotics and told me to rest.
Café habit: about four flat whites a week at the place by the office, roughly 22 a week.
Birthday ideas for my little sibling: a pottery class, the novel she kept mentioning, good headphones.
Went up the hill for a long run before work. Legs are sore but it felt good.
Coffee table arrived today. Assembly took an hour and one screw is missing.
Sister called about the plan for the family dinner on Sunday.
Car rental for the trip: pick up Friday at noon, return Monday by six.
Last day of the sprint. Shipped the export feature and finally slept properly.
Reading list: two books on habit formation and one on the history of maps.
Rainy walk by the river after lunch, then a quiet evening with a film.
Router keeps dropping the connection at night. Try a firmware update before calling support.
